whySixNotFive: build.gradle calls splitEnvironmentSourceSets and names sourceSets.client alongside main, and src/client holds GreatWallClient, GreatWallDebugClient and OverlayRenderer. Those compile to four classes because GreatWallDebugClient has a PageCache inner class, which is why the directory holds four under client.
